warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.blurb: A bulwark of muscle and steel. Outlasts anything that bleeds.

ability.name: Rampage
ability.desc: A reckless flurry dealing 220% weapon damage. Cannot crit, never misses.

mage.name: Mage
mage.blurb: Glass and fire. Ends fights before they start, or dies trying.

ability.name: Arcane Nova
ability.desc: Unleashes raw arcane force for 180% of INT as fire damage, ignoring defense.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.blurb: A blade in the dark. Strikes vital points and vanishes.

ability.name: Eviscerate
ability.desc: A guaranteed critical strike for 160% weapon damage with tripled crit damage.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.blurb: Faith made armor. Mends wounds and smites the wicked.

ability.name: Lay on Hands
ability.desc: Channels holy light, restoring 40% of max HP and smiting the foe for 120% of INT as light damage.
